description: Change a scheduled Ping in a room the account owns: only the fields you send change, and the next send is recalculated. enabled: false pauses it; true switches it back on (a free account keeps one on).

action_number.description: Press this Quick Ping slot instead of sending name. Slots 5 to 16 need Pro.

anchor_date.description: date_based only: the calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, in timezone.

date_direction.description: date_based only: count up since anchor_date, or down until it (which must still be ahead).

date_interval.description: date_based only: send every day, week or month.

enabled.description: Whether it sends. A new one is OFF unless you send true.

name.description: What the Ping says. Without it (and without action_number) it says "Scheduled Ping".

schedule_type.description: daily, weekly (days_of_week), monthly (day_of_month): repeat at trigger_time. specific: once, at trigger_at. date_based: count since or until anchor_date at trigger_time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the times are in, e.g. "Europe/London". Without it, UTC.

trigger_at.description: The one moment a specific schedule sends, in the future, e.g. "2026-12-24T18:00:00Z".

trigger_id.description: Scheduled Ping id from list_time_triggers or create_time_trigger.

trigger_time.description: Wall-clock time HH:MM (24-hour) in timezone. Required for daily, weekly, monthly and date_based.

name: update_time_trigger

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Scheduled Ping
